mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect fair conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look up tonight, the ISS will be visible starting at 5:02 PM, rising near Verona High School and traveling toward the Home Depot area.

Property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and payments can be made in two installments through the City of Verona Treasurer. Residents can pay online, by mail, or by using the 24-hour drop boxes at the City Center.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia tonight at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In a noteworthy incident on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
